dialect.detail: Uses ACCEPT/DISPLAY with AT row-column positioning and FOREGROUND-COLOR clauses, consistent with GnuCOBOL or Micro Focus screen-handling extensions. No EXEC SQL/CICS, no COMP-3. Brazilian Portuguese naming conventions.

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian payroll calculation: computes gross salary, overtime, INSS (social security) and IRRF (income tax) deductions, and net salary for an employee
purpose.summary: This program implements a Brazilian payroll (folha de pagamento) calculator. It accepts employee data (name, registration, CPF, RG, role, admission date, base salary, working hours, overtime, dependents) and computes gross salary, INSS and IRRF tax deductions using Brazilian tax brackets, and final net salary. Results are displayed on a character-mode screen using AT row-column positioning.

notable_features: ACCEPT/DISPLAY with AT row-column screen positioning
FOREGROUND-COLOR clause for colored terminal output
Brazilian tax bracket logic (INSS and IRRF)
Fixed-format source with continuation lines using '-' in column 7
No FILE SECTION files used despite FILE SECTION declared
verdict.notes: Program authored by Adriano Teles on 03/11/2016 per header comment. Uses Brazilian Portuguese identifiers and Brazilian tax rates (2016 values). The PERFORM count is 0 and CALL count is 0, indicating a single flat procedure. The screen-handling extensions (AT, FOREGROUND-COLOR) suggest GnuCOBOL or Micro Focus, but no definitive compiler directive is present.
